analysis_name: 재구축 패널 기반 사후적 시간외 정합성 검증(retrospective reconstructed-panel temporal validation)
approval: 사용자 2단계 실행 승인 및 10개 추가 준수조건
primary_comparison: fixed representative ELECTRE crisp versus final triage CHECK/additional-confirmation-or-higher; h=2 primary on common paired sample
immutable_definitions: CW-RBT-1.0 D/E/C/G/H/I/K/L: outcomes, periods, horizons, cutoffs, metrics, sensitivity specifications unchanged
constraints: Use the official analysis name; do not claim independent external validation, real-time backtesting or crisis prediction accuracy validation
No post-result changes to PROTOCOL definitions
Compute primary fixed crisp paired comparison first; parameter-space and observed possible-assignment sets are auxiliary
No observed RC/VRC filtering, including future RC2 and RC3
Separate common paired performance from missing-production operational coverage
Retain unfavorable and undefined results without posthoc adjustment
Allow INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE for sparse or concentrated events; no general model winner
Consolidated long-format CSVs; no per-parameter-draw files
Preserve existing final model and ELECTRE audit artifacts; write only separate rolling_backtest outputs
Stop performance calculation and report if solving a problem requires protocol definition changes
